verses.1: I want you to know that I have a great battle ahead of me, both for you and for those in Laodicea. And those who haven’t yet seen my face in its true form…
verses.2: So that their hearts may be called forth, and they may unite in love and for the sake of all the knowledge related to this unity. So that they may understand the mystery of God, Christ.
verses.3: In it are hidden all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.
verses.4: I say this so that none of you may be misled by such possibilities.
verses.5: For even though I have flesh like all people, yet my spirit is with you. I rejoice and see your order and the strength of your faith in Christ.
verses.6: Therefore, when you receive Christ Jesus, the Lord, let yourselves be carried along in Him.
verses.7: We are pleased and excited to be involved in this project, and we firmly believe in the trust that has been placed in us. We express our gratitude for this.
verses.8: See that you do not become one of those who are organized through philosophy and empty deception, according to the ways of people, according to the elements of the world, not according to Christ.
verses.9: Because in him physically resides all the fullness of divinity.
verses.10: And it also includes those elements that are necessary for its completion. This is what constitutes the head of every beginning and every authority.
verses.11: In which place also you were circumcised by the sword, at the time of the body’s separation from its flesh; in the circumcision of Christ.
verses.12: Those who were baptized with him, in that baptism, they also were united with him through the faith in the work of the resurrected God.
verses.13: And while you were dead in those remains and in the state of decay of your flesh, He made you whole again, along with Him. He restored all of our bodily parts to their proper function.
verses.14: You have removed from among us that manuscript that contained the teachings that were contrary to our beliefs. It was then placed at the center of the cross.
verses.15: He took away their powers and authority as examples, thereby humiliating them.
verses.16: So, no one should judge you based on your wealth, or the amount of food you have, or your status in society, or whether it’s Sunday or not.
verses.17: That is the shadow of those who are to come; while the body of Christ is the real thing.
verses.18: No one among you should be punished out of humility and respect for the messages of the prophets. What he sees when he enters is something that is natural to his body, as determined by the laws of nature.
verses.19: And without holding the head in place, all of the body was adorned and decorated with decorations and bonds, thereby increasing the growth of God’s glory.
verses.20: If you die along with Christ, from the elements of the world, then what do you have to teach others when you live in this world?
verses.21: Do not touch, do not taste, and do not chew it.
verses.22: Everything ends in decay and uselessness, according to the ways of human actions and teachings.
verses.23: It is true that those who possess wisdom, along with humility and a humble demeanor, and whose bodies are also healthy, do not seek any kind of honor or glory from the physical world.
